newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shipping firm to take delivery of VLCC.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shipping firm to take delivery of VLCC.

text.p: National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia (NSCSA) said on Monday it will take delivery of its fourth very large crude carrier (VLCC) on October 31.
The 300,000 dwt Hawtah will be named on that date at a ceremony at Mitsubishi Heavy Industries' shipyard at Nagasaki, Japan, the company said.
NSCSA, 28.8 percent owned by the Saudi government, has already taken delivery of three VLCCs and has a fifth vesel, the Safaniah, due for delivery on January 14.
The ships will carry crude produced by state oil firm Saudi Aramco under an agreement signed with Aramco shipping arm Vela International Marine in March.
